verdict.rationale: Docs describe a dedicated Compare mode for baseline vs. candidate (docs-12). You register a new agent version and compare it against the previous one on the same tasks and starting state (docs-10, docs-2), using task suites (docs-11). Runs pin frozen task/scorer versions so results stay comparable (docs-13), and you can inspect the recorded actions behind each score to diagnose failures. Missing for 10: specifics of the side-by-side view or automatic regression flagging/score diffs, explicit framing for prompt vs. model changes rather than generic agent versions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
